prompt_inputs.goal: Prepare for a marathon with high-intensity long training session (18+ km run) scheduled for afternoon

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all meals and snacks for one full day in compact format
Includes carbohydrate-rich foods strategically timed before and after the long afternoon training session
Provides adequate hydration and electrolyte guidance aligned with endurance athlete needs
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific timing around long training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle mass and increase strength through optimized nutrition around weightlifting sessions

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains at least 4 meals distributed throughout the day with strategic pre/post-workout timing
Total daily protein is at least 1.7g per kg of body weight (145g+) with balanced distribution across meals
Includes calorie-dense foods supporting muscle building goals with sufficient carbohydrates for training performance
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing high protein distribution and caloric density for muscle building with multiple meal timing around gym sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain peak performance and muscle recovery for competitive football
prompt_inputs.restrictions: Vegan (no animal products including meat, fish, dairy, eggs, honey)

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals plus snacks for one full day
All foods are vegan-compliant with no animal products
Includes adequate plant-based protein sources (legumes, tofu, nuts, seeds) to support athletic recovery and performance
Nutritionally balanced for a competitive athlete's caloric and macronutrient needs
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete with dietary restrictions (vegan football player) requiring alternative protein sources while maintaining competitive performance nutrition standards
